settings.block_description: Dr. Spencer Proctor is a Professor and Department Chair at the University of Alberta with expertise in Nutritional Sciences and Biomedical Research. Dr. Proctor has a long-standing track record in Team Sports, Individual Endurance, Athletics/Track and Sports Nutrition. Spencer has spent much of his career as an active age group athlete and accumulated provincial and national accolades. Spencer is an accomplished coach in team sports and more recently achieved certifications in the National Coaching Certification Pathway.With scientific experience in the testing of intestinal absorption pathways and a real-world appreciation of electrolyte balance and the importance of hydration systems in healthy and clinical situations, Dr. Proctor provides a wealth of knowledge for Best Hydrate. We appreciate having the leadership and scientific direction from Dr. Proctor and believe it can benefit not only the position of the Best Hydrate brand, but benefit all of our patrons and customers. Born and raised around Edmonton, Alberta, Austin is the visionary founder behind Best Hydrate.A boiler engineer by career and a self-taught expert in various fields, Austin's entrepreneurial journey began at the age of 18 when he built a pilot-scale aquaponics system. Over the years, he worked on more than ten businesses, driven by a relentless pursuit to find a meaningful calling.Austin's path took a life-threatening turn when he was hospitalized due to an autoimmune disease. This personal battle underscored the critical, yet often overlooked, role of hydration in health and longevity.In 2020, inspired by his discoveries that he needed more electrolytes aka salts (not less!), and in spite of the current "hydration" options with their high sugar and low salt,  he started to create his own formulation at home. As a result of his formula he had an amazing health transformation and so Best Hydrate was founded in 2021. He's founded a team that is determined to transform health via innovative & superior hydration. We do this by redefining hydration as not "simple and just water" but instead by focusing on the elegant interweaving and interplay of water, nutrition, bio-electro-chemistry, and medicine.

Also, born and raised in Northern Alberta, I am a Registered Nurse with a 16 year career in Research and Management.I co-founded Best Hydrate, an electrolyte mix Company that creates real-life options for every day problems to help you become more effective to living your Best Life.With Best Hydrate, I am following a life-long journey of being able to better the lives of people in a profound and meaningful way.

settings.text:
Best Hydrate comes from wanting better options from too many retail options with high sugar content and very little science.

In a world inundated with "green washing" and an apparent need for real science a formula was created in order to be the Best alternative. 

So with extensive research and the unwavering support of family and friends, here we are, 5 years later!

An Alberta grass roots company founded on simple, tasty, research-based hydration.

Excited and dedicated to not being another overly sugary, fluffy and complicated electrolyte drink but one that is more than just a quick fix. With only 6 ingredients, Best Hydrate is optimally balanced and designed for the BEST in Hydration. It hydrates you throughout the day without the spikes and drops from other products' excess sugars.

We are committed to being transparent, open and honest.

All of our ingredients are naturally sourced and Non-GMO.

Best Hydrate is mixed and packaged in Edmonton, Alberta.

settings.heading: Why is there glucose?
settings.row_content: Now, don’t be fooled by “zero-sugar” claims! Proper hydration, requires the right balance of glucose to drive optimal absorption of water in the cells. Our formula keeps sugar content low—about 1/10th of what’s found in typical sports drinks—without compromising effectiveness.

settings.heading: What is ORS?
settings.row_content: Oral Rehydration Solution is a simple solution used to prevent and treat dehydration. ORS contains a precise balance of electrolytes and carbohydrates mixed with water.

settings.heading: Can I use Best Hydrate daily?
settings.row_content: Yes, Best Hydrate can be used daily to help maintain hydration levels, especially during exercise or hot weather.

settings.heading: Where can I purchase Best Hydrate?
settings.row_content: Best Hydrate is available on our official website and Amazon.

settings.heading: How to take Best Hydrate Electrolyte Mix
settings.row_content:
1. Dosage: Put one scoop into 500mL/16oz of drinking water (or two scoops into one liter/32oz)
  2. Let dissolve - Shake or Stir (~20 seconds)
  3. Drink one liter/32oz per day for BEST results
  4. Discard unused solution after 12 hrs., or 48 hrs. if refrigerated
  5. Do not mix Best Hydrate with soft drinks, sports drinks, or fruit juices
  6. See peel-back label for more details.

settings.title: Glucose
settings.text:
Glucose, the simplest form of sugar, serves as the primary energy source
for all cells in our bodies. Additionally, glucose is essential for
facilitating rapid hydration through advanced technologies such as
Sodium Glucose Linked Transport (SGLT), which efficiently transports
both sodium and glucose to support hydration processes within the body.

settings.title: Potassium
settings.text: Potassium is the predominant electrolyte found within your cells. It is among the more challenging electrolytes to obtain through our typical diet.

settings.title: Salt
settings.text:
Sodium and Chloride are the most common electrolytes in your blood and needs constant replenishment. When you consume salt, it can help
increase your thirst and encourage you to drink more water, leading to
better hydration.

settings.title: Citric Acid
settings.text: Citric acid is used for flavor enhancement, antioxidant protection, and as a source of citrate for energy production. Its versatile properties improve taste, effectiveness, and stability of the product.
